digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 23 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「其他热门」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: usestrix/strix
repos.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.

repos.name: longbridge/gpui-component
repos.description: Rust GUI components for building fantastic cross-platform desktop application by using GPUI.

repos.description: A full-featured download manager.
